card: Describe a teacher who taught you something useful.
pts: what subject or skill they taught you
and explain why it was useful to you
model:
I'd like to talk about my English teacher at secondary school. She was a calm woman in her forties, and everybody in the class respected her. She taught us English, but she also taught us how to study properly, which was the most useful lesson of all.

As for her method, she never just gave us the answers. Instead, she asked us to work in small groups and explain the grammar to each other. At first I felt shy, but after a few weeks I started to enjoy it. She also made us keep a notebook for new words, and every Thursday she tested five of them. It sounds simple, but it really worked.

The reason this was so useful is that I still use the same habits today. When I read an article about law or technology, I write down the new words and review them at the weekend. Thanks to her, I can now read English papers for my studies without feeling lost.

To sum up, she did not only teach me a language. She taught me how to learn, and that is something I will keep for the rest of my life. I am really grateful to her.
phr: The reason this was so useful is that...
tipAr: ابدأ بجملة تقديم واضحة ثم اتبع النقاط الأربع بالترتيب، واستخدم أدوات الربط مثل As for وThe reason لتبدو إجابتك منظمة.

card: Describe a relative you enjoy spending time with.
pts: and explain why you enjoy their company
model:
I'm going to describe my uncle, my father's younger brother. He is about forty-five and works as a civil engineer in a nearby city. He is tall, funny and always wears a big smile.

We don't live in the same town, so I see him about once a month, usually at the weekend. During the holidays, we meet more often because he comes to stay at my grandparents' house, and the whole family gathers there.

When we are together, we usually do a few simple things. We go for a long walk in the morning, then we cook lunch together. He is a really good cook, and he always lets me help. In the evening, we sometimes play board games with my cousins, and he never lets me win!

The reason I enjoy his company is that he listens carefully. When I was worried about my exams last year, he did not tell me what to do. He just asked questions and helped me find my own answer. Also, he has a great sense of humour, so I never feel bored with him.

In short, he is like an older brother to me, and I always look forward to our next meeting.
phr: We don't live in the same town, so...
The reason I enjoy... is that...
tipAr: لا تذكر الاسم الحقيقي للشخص؛ يكفي أن تقول my uncle أو my cousin، وركّز على التفاصيل الحية مثل الأنشطة والمواقف.

card: Describe a city you have visited and liked.
pts: and explain why you liked it
model:
I'd like to describe Constantine, a beautiful city in the north-east of Algeria. It is famous for its high bridges and its deep valley, and it is about four hours from my hometown by car.

I went there two years ago, in spring, with three university friends. We had just finished our exams, so we wanted a short trip to relax. The weather was perfect, not too hot and not too cold.

Once we arrived, we left our bags at a small hotel and went straight to the old town. We walked across one of the long bridges, took a lot of photos and visited a museum. After that, we tried some local sweets in a tiny shop near the market. In the evening, we took a cable car and watched the lights of the city from above. It was unforgettable.

The reason I liked it so much is that it feels different from anywhere else I know. The buildings are old, but the people are modern and friendly. Everything was also quite cheap, which is important for students.

To be honest, I would love to go back one day, perhaps with my family, because there is still so much more to see.
tipAr: استخدم الماضي البسيط عند الحديث عن الرحلة (went, visited, tried) وتجنب الخلط بينه وبين المضارع.

card: Describe a quiet place where you like to go.
pts: and explain why it is quiet and special for you
model:
The quiet place I'd like to talk about is the public library in my city. It is a big old building near the town hall, with high windows and long wooden tables.

I go there about three times a week, mostly in the afternoon after my classes. During exam periods, I sometimes spend the whole day there, with only a short break for lunch.

When I'm there, I usually find a seat near the window on the second floor. First, I put my phone on silent and take out my notebook. Then I read for my law course or practise English with some articles. Sometimes I just sit and think about my plans for the future. It's a good place to organise my ideas.

The reason it feels so special is that everybody respects the silence. Nobody talks loudly, and there are no noisy cars, because the library is in a small street. Also, the smell of old books makes me feel calm and focused. At home, it is harder to concentrate because there are always visitors and a television in the living room.

All in all, it's my second home, and I believe I study better there than anywhere else.
phr: The quiet place I'd like to talk about is...
I go there about... times a week
The reason it feels so special is that...
tipAr: استعمل كلمات الترتيب First وThen وAlso لتربط الأفكار، فهذا يمنحك سلاسة أكثر في الكلام.

card: Describe a book you read and enjoyed.
pts: and explain why you enjoyed it
model:
I'm going to talk about a short novel about a young man who wants to become a judge in a small village. I read it last summer, during the long holidays, when I had a lot of free time.

The story is about a student from a poor family who works in a shop in the morning and studies at night. He sees that some people in his village receive help from officials only because they know them. He feels this is unfair, so he decides to study law and make things fairer. The story follows him for about ten years, and at the end he finally gets his dream job.

I enjoyed the book for several reasons. First, the language was simple, so I could read it quickly. Second, the main character is very realistic. He makes mistakes, gets discouraged and even wants to give up at one point, but he keeps trying. That made me feel I could do the same with my own goals.

Also, the book made me think about justice and honesty in everyday life, which is an interest of mine.

In conclusion, it was a lovely and inspiring story, and I would recommend it to any student.
phr: I enjoyed the book for several reasons.
tipAr: عند وصف كتاب استعمل المضارع لتلخيص القصة (The story is about...) والماضي لما فعلته أنت (I read it).

card: Describe a gift you gave to someone.
pts: and explain how the person felt about it
model:
I'd like to talk about a gift I gave to my mother last year for her birthday. It was a small digital photo frame, and I filled it with more than a hundred family pictures.

I chose it for a few reasons. My mother loves looking at old photos, but they were all in boxes in the cupboard, and she never had time to take them out. Also, I did not have much money as a student, so I needed something useful but not too expensive. Then I remembered the frame in a shop and thought it would be perfect.

Before her birthday, I asked my sister to help me. We scanned the old photos in secret and put them in the frame. It took us two evenings, and we had to be careful because my mother was always at home.

When she opened the box, she was very surprised. At first she did not say anything, and then her eyes filled with tears. She said it was the best gift she had ever received, and she put it in the living room straight away.

To be honest, her reaction made me happier than any gift I have ever received myself.
phr: I chose it for a few reasons.
tipAr: قصة صغيرة عن ردّة فعل الشخص تجعل إجابتك أكثر حيوية، فأضف دائماً مشهداً واحداً يمكن تخيّله.

pts: and explain why you enjoyed it
model:
I'm going to talk about my cousin's wedding, which took place two summers ago in my grandfather's village. It was the biggest family celebration I have ever attended.

Almost eighty people came, including uncles, aunts, neighbours and friends from other towns. I was happy to meet relatives I had not seen for years. The whole house was decorated with lights and flowers, and there was a long table in the garden.

During the party, a lot of things happened. First, we all had a big meal together, with traditional dishes that my aunts had cooked for two days. After that, some young men played music, and the children ran around and danced. Later in the evening, my grandfather made a short speech, and everybody clapped. I helped to serve tea and sweets, so I was busy but also very cheerful.

The reason I enjoyed it so much is that the whole family was together in one place. In everyday life, we are always busy with our studies and jobs, so we rarely see each other. That night, everybody was relaxed and laughing.

In short, it was a warm, noisy and happy evening that I will remember for a long time.
phr: The reason I enjoyed it so much is that...
tipAr: لا تكتفِ بقول It was nice؛ صِف ما رأيت وسمعت (الأضواء، الموسيقى، الطعام) لتجعل إجابتك أغنى.

card: Describe your first day at university or at a new school.
pts: and explain how you felt about it
model:
I'd like to describe my first day at university, which was four years ago in September. I had just finished high school, and I was both excited and nervous.

The university is in a larger city, about two hours from my home. I left my house very early with my father, because I did not want to be late. When we arrived, the campus was full of students, and I could not find my faculty. In the end, a friendly older student showed me the way.

During the day, I attended an introduction lecture in a huge hall with more than two hundred students. After that, we received our timetables and met our group leader. At lunchtime, I sat alone for a few minutes, but then a boy next to me started a conversation. We discovered that we both liked technology, and we have been friends ever since.

As for my feelings, in the morning I was a little afraid because everything was new and big. However, by the evening I felt much more confident and happy.

Looking back, that day was the start of an important chapter in my life, and I'm glad I stayed positive.
tipAr: في هذه البطاقة عبّر عن مشاعرك بكلمات متنوعة مثل nervous وexcited وconfident بدل تكرار happy.

card: Describe a time when you helped someone.
pts: and explain how you felt afterwards
model:
I'd like to talk about a time when I helped an elderly neighbour. It happened about a year ago, in winter, when I was coming back from the university.

He is a kind man in his seventies who lives alone on the first floor of our building. That evening, I saw him standing outside the door with a lot of shopping bags, and he looked very tired. The lift was broken, and he could not carry the bags up the stairs.

So I offered to help. I took the heavy bags and walked slowly with him to his flat. After that, I put the food in his kitchen and checked that he was fine. He wanted to give me some money, but I refused politely. Then he asked me to have a cup of tea with him, and we talked for half an hour about his life as a young teacher.

Afterwards, I felt very pleased with myself. It was a small thing to do, but it made a big difference for him. Also, I learned that older people often just need someone to talk to.

Since then, I say hello to him every day, and sometimes I do his shopping on Saturdays.
phr: I'd like to talk about a time when...
tipAr: اجعل القصة مرتبة زمنياً: ماذا حدث أولاً ثم بعد ذلك، واختم بما شعرت به وما تعلمته.

card: Describe a goal you would like to achieve in the future.
pts: when you want to achieve it
what you need to do to reach it
and explain why it is important to you
model:
I'm going to talk about my main goal, which is to continue my studies abroad and become a researcher. I would like to do a doctorate in a good university and work on how technology can help to make public services fairer.

I hope to start in about three years, once I finish my master's degree. It's a long way, but I think it is realistic if I stay serious.

To reach this goal, I need to do several things. First, I have to improve my English, especially my speaking and academic writing, so I practise every day. Second, I want to publish a few articles to show that I can do real research. Finally, I need to save some money for application fees and travel, so I do small online jobs when I have free time.

The reason it is so important to me is that I want to do something useful for my country and for other people. I also believe that education is the best way to change my life. Many young people in my region have talent, but they do not always have the chance to show it.

In short, this goal gives me energy every morning, and I will not give up easily.
phr: I'm going to talk about my main goal, which is to...
To reach this goal, I need to...
The reason it is so important to me is that...
tipAr: عند الحديث عن الأهداف استخدم I would like to وI hope to وI plan to بدلاً من تكرار I want to.
